test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. B is sitting third to the right of C. No one is sitting to the left of C. Only four people are sitting between A and B. Only two people are seated to the right of D. Only four people are sitting between A and D. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated between C and D?
solution:
According to the given information, a certain number of people are sitting in a row facing north whose arrangement is shown below,

1) B is sitting third to the right of C. No one is sitting to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566b50b3aedcc83a0dfe8446a4c07c7e39773574cf2992c9b0871d6571aa8cc1.png] 

2) Only four people are sitting between A and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/799cb17955617e9ad0acc659aebaeb7984ff08c44df0ed6a5a8376ce807baa8d.png] 

3) Only four people are sitting between A and D and only two people are seated to the right of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32a24f7551a49a6aa212ca50ce9cfece55a1c840c33f417762b41d39a63c2154.png] 

Thus, as per the above arrangement, there are 12 persons seated between C and D.

Hence, the correct answer is **'12'.**
